text.p: Following are some of the main stories in Dutch newspapers today. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Dutch PTT to split in two, separating post and telcoms businesses (p1)
- Philips alliance with Lucent will be world leader in telephone manufacturing. (p1)
- Dutch investigate possibility of pork exports to North Korea (p5)
- Software firm ICT to list on Amsterdam Exchanges (p11)
- EU leaders duck question of Union's expansion at Amsterdam summit (p1)
- Environmental movement willing to negotiate over growth of Schiphol airport (p1)
- KPN split to be concluded by early 1998 (p25)
- Doctors, pharmacists worried by internet medicines ordering services. (p1)
- Ajax winger Marc Overmars signs for London club Arsenal.
- Transport of East European livestock raises fears of foot-and-mouth disease in the Netherlands (p13)
